Cellin Clinic Hongdae in Seoul offers Sculptra. Sculptra is different from conventional fillers that directly add moisture or hyaluronic acid for volume. It is a "collagen stimulator" that uses PLLA (Poly-L-Lactic Acid), an FDA-approved ingredient, injected into the skin to stimulate the skin's own collagen regeneration.
One session 790,000 KRW.

位于首尔的 Cellin 诊所 弘大店提供 Sculptra。Sculptra 不同于直接补充水分或玻尿酸来增加容量的传统填充剂，它是一种"胶原蛋白刺激剂"，将经 FDA 批准的成分 PLLA（聚左旋乳酸）注射到皮肤中，刺激皮肤自身的胶原蛋白再生。
每次 790,000 韩元。
